newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Belgian CCB Holding bourse listing Nov 20 - paper.
newsitem.headline: Belgian CCB Holding bourse listing Nov 20 - paper.

text.p: Credit Communal de Belgique (CCB)/Gemeentekrediet Holding, formed as part of CCB's planned link-up with Credit Local de France (CLF), will be listed on the Brussels bourse on November 20, the Belgian newspaper De Standaard said on Saturday.

Under the alliance of the two banking groups, which has been approved by CCB and CLF shareholders, each parent sets up a holding company in order to take a 50-percent stake in their partner's operational bank.
The alliance, called Dexia, will create Europe's 22nd largest banking group. The CCB Holding shares will be listed under the Dexia name, De Standaard said.
Up to 30 percent of CCB Holding's capital will be sold in the initial public offering, while the rest remains in the hands of the bank's municipal shareholders.
De Standaard said the subscription period to the offer would last from November 8 to 15 for retail investors, and November 4 to 15 for institutionals.

It said CCB had applied to list 12.67 million shares. The offer price was not known but analysts estimated it at about 2,650 Belgian francs a share, the paper added, which would raise 33.6 billion francs.
